grh_42ed2db188507a3792eb.title: The Lady and the Outlaw
paragraphs: English traveler Isabella Bird arrives in the Colorado Rockies determined to recover the freedom and health she never found in a sheltered life. Against local warnings, she chooses notorious Rocky Mountain Jim Nugent to guide her up Longs Peak, the dangerous summit she has set her heart on reaching. During the climb Jim proves capable and protective, while confiding the losses, drinking and violence that turned him into a feared outlaw, and Isabella comes to see the troubled man beneath his reputation. They survive the difficult ascent and return to civilization, where Jim even attends a social gathering in her honor and restrains himself when challenged. Isabella then resumes her travels, leaving behind a man briefly restored to the better self she had recognized in him.

grh_423d4c757ef97aa6f811.title: Light On A Fallen Star
paragraphs: Navy test pilot Grant Hopper survives a fiery crash without major physical injury, but afterward becomes terrified of flame, smoke, sudden noises and even ordinary reminders of flying. His fear turns him bitter and withdrawn from wife Helen and young daughter Dodie, whose admiration for her once-fearless father only deepens his shame. Dr. Christian recognizes that Grant's real injury is psychological and looks for a way to reconnect him with the courage and responsibility he believes he has lost. When Dodie is endangered by a fire, Grant rushes into the flames to save her. The rescue breaks the grip of the crash on him, and Grant realizes that in going into the fire for his daughter he recovered the part of himself he thought had been destroyed.

grh_4289171a5a074a1d6367.title: The Big Freeze
paragraphs: Businessman Joe learns that an incurable heart condition will kill him within months and agrees to become the first human subject of an experimental deep-freeze technique, hoping doctors can revive him after a cure is developed. Before treatment he becomes obsessed with securing his wife Dottie's future and violently confronts his business partner Rico. Two years later doctors have perfected the needed heart surgery and revive Joe successfully. They also reveal that the critically wounded Rico was preserved by the same method and has survived as well, confronting Joe with the man he expected never to see again while the life he left behind has changed permanently.
